description: The relationships ThreatNexus dossiers state for an actor (subgroup, overlaps, related-to, similar), one or two hops out, as nodes and edges with confidence. Also lists other actors whose dossiers share distinctive malware or CVEs with it — computed overlap, not a stated relationship.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

name: explore_relationships
title: An actor's relationship graph
